about: Memory retrieval fixture (2026-10-17), written before any resolver was measured on it. Look-alike groups share words on purpose (seat, coffee, Priya, kept, meeting, laptop, travel). Each query names the ONE memory a person would mean; 'want' is that memory's index in 'memories' (0-based). Used by jarvis/evals/memory_retrieval.py (hit@1, MRR) and test_memory_retrieval.py.
